nodes.label: GLB node hierarchy vs triangles
nodes.rationale: Triangles are GPU primitives, not marble blocks; meaningful decomposition requires separating node hierarchy (Blender Separate by Loose Parts/Material).

nodes.label: Procedural geometry generation
nodes.rationale: No downloadable model has drum-by-drum granularity; code generates every buildable piece. The downloaded photogrammetry (modern Acropolis) was dropped as anachronistic for 440 BC.

nodes.label: Parametric heightfield plateau
nodes.rationale: Gives an editable, historically coherent plateau instead of the modern scan with 19th-century retaining walls.

nodes.label: Mason marks (marche da cantiere, e.g. KIWN 14/d)
nodes.rationale: Greek masons really marked blocks for assembly.
nodes.norm_label: mason marks (marche da cantiere, e.g. kiwn 14/d)

nodes.label: Token-to-stone ghost block placement
nodes.rationale: Block descends as verdigris ghost and solidifies; mirrors historical crane hoisting.

nodes.label: Periclean complex (Promachos, Propylaea, Athena Nike, Erechtheion)
nodes.norm_label: periclean complex (promachos, propylaea, athena nike, erechtheion)

nodes.label: Analytic sky (Rayleigh + Mie scattering, PMREMGenerator IBL)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over HDRI so time of day is a continuous parameter; sun position from real equations at Athens latitude 37.97N.
nodes.norm_label: analytic sky (rayleigh + mie scattering, pmremgenerator ibl)

nodes.label: bakePhase() mesh merging
nodes.rationale: Merges a closed phase's meshes per material, cutting draw calls from thousands to dozens.

nodes.label: /usage estimation bridge (usage_store.py)
nodes.rationale: Claude Code usage not exposed via API; two calibrations give a rate extrapolated until next reading. Superseded in §10 by transcript counting.

nodes.label: Optical refinements (REFINEMENTS in config.js)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate corrections against optical illusion; each toggleable with on:false for comparison.

nodes.label: Stylobate curvature (makeCurve)
nodes.rationale: Returns height and local slope so blocks are tilted, not only raised; crepidoma split from 36 to 108 pieces.

nodes.label: Column inward inclination (1:171, per-face)
nodes.rationale: Single convergence point gave 157mm at corners vs ~65 attested; inclination is constant per face, applied drum by drum with spin composed before tilt.

nodes.label: Angle contraction of corner intercolumniations
nodes.rationale: Lets the triglyph fall on the entablature corner without mutilating the corner metope.

nodes.label: Polychromy (POLYCHROMY.on)
nodes.rationale: White marble is a modern misconception; paint applied as details within existing pieces so build cost is unchanged.

nodes.label: Bedrock is free, everything carried up is paid
nodes.rationale: Makes the game legible: what you see was either bought or is geology.
nodes.norm_label: bedrock is free, everything carried up is paid

nodes.label: North wall with Themistocles' reused drums
nodes.rationale: Drums placed at absolute height inside wall face (shared coping function in terrain.js), spaced by arc-length table, not angle.
nodes.norm_label: north wall with themistocles' reused drums

nodes.label: Brauronion and Chalkotheke
nodes.rationale: Built with the same kit, verifying the kit works beyond its five original cases.

nodes.label: Determinism via fixed-seed generator
nodes.rationale: Saved state is an index into the piece list; if order changed per reload the index would point elsewhere. Later moved to engine/random.js unchanged line by line.

nodes.label: Token Equivalent (TE, te_per_usd = 200,000)
nodes.rationale: Tokens priced via list price then converted, so one TE equals one Opus input token; avoids rewarding cache reads over output.

nodes.label: Recompute, never sum (idempotent counter)
nodes.rationale: A summing counter double-counts if triggered twice; a recomputing one is harmless to repeat.

nodes.label: Streaming dedup: one row per message.id
nodes.norm_label: streaming dedup: one row per message.id

nodes.label: State backup copy (corrupt vs absent state)
nodes.rationale: Corrupt state used to reset installed_at and discard history; unreadable state now restores from backup, absent state remains an intentional reset.
nodes.norm_label: state backup copy (corrupt vs absent state)

nodes.label: COST as relative weights, not prices
nodes.rationale: Proportions decided by hand; a single budget sets the scale.
nodes.norm_label: cost as relative weights, not prices

nodes.label: Weekly quota scale (CANTIERE.weeklyTe, one month per Acropolis)
nodes.norm_label: weekly quota scale (cantiere.weeklyte, one month per acropolis)

nodes.label: ?dev mode switch (single project)
nodes.rationale: One project with a switch instead of two copies, because duplicated code diverges within a week.

nodes.label: Single-threaded static server bug ('Failed to fetch dynamically imported module')
nodes.norm_label: single-threaded static server bug ('failed to fetch dynamically imported module')

nodes.label: Hookless scanning of ~/.claude/projects
nodes.rationale: Stop hook required editing ~/.claude/settings.json and running a stranger's script everywhere; data came from transcripts anyway. Handles resumed sessions, deletions (archived), incremental reads.

nodes.label: installed_at: start from zero
nodes.rationale: Prior months of usage are not gifted as credit; the building site starts when the project arrives.

nodes.label: Pricing list (pricing.json, unknown_models, model_fallbacks, fast_multiplier)
nodes.rationale: Most specific prefix wins; validated by shape only since cache-read ratio varies by model; synthetic messages ignored.

nodes.label: aggiorna-listino subagent (propose then apply)
nodes.rationale: No pricing API; an agent reads the pricing page like a person, dry-runs the counter, and replaces pricing.json only with explicit approval.

nodes.label: Single language: Node server with in-process counter
nodes.rationale: Rewrite the trivial 90-line Python server, not the 900-line tested counter; no pipe, no orphan processes, zero-dependency package.json.
nodes.norm_label: single language: node server with in-process counter

nodes.label: Server security (localhost only, no traversal/hidden files, JSON-only writes)
nodes.norm_label: server security (localhost only, no traversal/hidden files, json-only writes)

nodes.label: Double-click launchers and PWA service worker
nodes.rationale: Server only needed to watch, not to count; service worker only shows help page when server is off, keeps no stale scene copies.
nodes.norm_label: double-click launchers and pwa service worker

nodes.label: Progress computed from credit (not saved)
nodes.rationale: Browser-local progress diverged across profiles; computing placed blocks from ordered piece costs and credit yields the same site everywhere.

nodes.label: Registry (state/registry.json, formerly world/cantiere.json)
nodes.rationale: Records active world and time segments; pause/resume, leftover credit carried to next world, high-water mark so the site never regresses.

nodes.label: Engine/world separation (engine/ vs worlds/acropolis/, startWorld)
nodes.rationale: Engine holds what is equal everywhere; Greek kit stays in Acropolis until a second world needs it, to avoid guessing its shape.

nodes.label: Scene file version fingerprint and auto-reload
nodes.rationale: A stale tab kept placing blocks with an inflated browser-side balance; fingerprint triggers reload, three missed polls show 'scollegato dal cantiere'.
nodes.norm_label: scene file version fingerprint and auto-reload

nodes.label: TokenStone home page (world selection)
nodes.rationale: Visiting is not choosing; registry starts empty and the first chosen world receives all TE since install.

nodes.label: Measured weekly quota (66 million TE)
nodes.rationale: Rounded /usage readings form intervals; true value lies in their overlap (65.0-67.2M). Panel shows 'Mancano' instead of negative credit.

nodes.label: World folder layout (world.json, index.html, src/main.js, preview.webp)
nodes.norm_label: world folder layout (world.json, index.html, src/main.js, preview.webp)

nodes.label: world.json fields (id, order, status, weeks, solar, preview)
nodes.rationale: weeks sets the price: world budget = WEEKLY_TE (engine/config.js) x weeks.
nodes.norm_label: world.json fields (id, order, status, weeks, solar, preview)

nodes.label: addPiece(phase, object, weight, mark, description, drop)
nodes.norm_label: addpiece(phase, object, weight, mark, description, drop)

nodes.label: Piece order invariant after publication
nodes.rationale: Registry stores 'first N of the list'; reordering would make N point at other pieces. New pieces only appended.

nodes.label: startWorld({meta, build, phases, completion, view, sun, fog, hour, snapshot, focus})
nodes.norm_label: startworld({meta, build, phases, completion, view, sun, fog, hour, snapshot, focus})

nodes.label: Greek architecture kit (worlds/acropolis/src/kit.js)
nodes.rationale: Moves to a shared place when a second world needs it, instead of being copied.

nodes.label: Publishing a world (status available, npm test, test:scene, commit)
nodes.norm_label: publishing a world (status available, npm test, test:scene, commit)

nodes.label: TokenStone (piattaforma di mondi)
nodes.rationale: Worlds built step by step with Claude Code token usage; one world lasts weeks or months; engine is shared, each world brings only what makes it itself. Name is provisional.

nodes.label: Mondo: Acropoli di Pericle
nodes.rationale: 3,280 independent pieces with cost, mason's mark and historical phase, sized for about a month at 100% weekly Claude Code usage.

nodes.label: Mondo in arrivo: Piana di Giza
nodes.norm_label: mondo in arrivo: piana di giza

nodes.label: Token Equivalenti (TE)
nodes.rationale: Dollar cost at list price converted via te_per_usd (200,000): one TE = one Opus input token. Weighs tokens of different models on the same scale; the dollar value is only shown in a note because subscribers don't pay it.

nodes.label: Registro dei mondi (state/registry.json)
nodes.rationale: The counter knows only one total; the registry splits it among worlds via segments of the total, remembers the highest point reached per world (so price drops never un-build) and each world's cost (to compute carryover).

nodes.label: Tratti di credito (un mondo attivo alla volta)
nodes.norm_label: tratti di credito (un mondo attivo alla volta)

nodes.label: Pausa e avanzo del credito
nodes.rationale: A half-built world keeps its credit when paused; a completed world passes surplus to the next chosen one, which waits and is never lost.

nodes.label: I blocchi posati si calcolano, non si salvano
nodes.rationale: Given credit and ordered piece costs, placed blocks are a computation; the site is identical in every browser/device and nothing of progress lives in the browser.
nodes.norm_label: i blocchi posati si calcolano, non si salvano

nodes.label: Prezzo dei pezzi da pesi relativi (priceInTe)
nodes.rationale: COST values are relative weights; budget = weeklyTe * weeks, cost(p) = weight(p) * budget / sum(weights), so the total stays exact when pieces are added while hand-tuned proportions are preserved.
nodes.norm_label: prezzo dei pezzi da pesi relativi (priceinte)

nodes.label: Misura di CANTIERE.weeklyTe (66 milioni TE)
nodes.rationale: Weekly TE value is not public and plan-dependent; measured from /usage percentage plus counter --dry-run --since: weeklyTe = total_te / pct * 100. Two readings (12% and 19%) bound it to 65.0-67.2M; earlier 31M reading was polluted by claude.ai use. 5-hour window is a different limit and is not used.

nodes.label: Contatore di token (transcript Claude Code)
nodes.rationale: Reads ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl every five seconds, weighs usage at list price and rewrites state/world-state.json; counts all projects, only after first start (installed_at), only on this computer; runs inside the server so no orphan processes.

nodes.label: Privacy: solo message.usage, modello, orario, cartella
nodes.rationale: Message text, questions, answers and code are never read or copied; nothing goes to the network; state stays in state/.
nodes.norm_label: privacy: solo message.usage, modello, orario, cartella

nodes.label: Le scelte che proteggono il conto
nodes.rationale: Recompute never sum (idempotent scans); one message counted once (highest output per message.id, first session wins); subagents roll into parent session; deleted sessions kept as archived; tail-only reads; backup .world-state.bak; atomic write + .world-state.lock; single process inside the server.
nodes.norm_label: le scelte che proteggono il conto

nodes.label: Listino prezzi modelli (pricing.json)
nodes.rationale: Re-read every cycle so corrections apply without restart. Models matched by exact name or dated suffix; unknown versions priced from nearest entry but flagged in unknown_models/model_fallbacks. fast_multiplier covers /fast mode; <synthetic> messages don't count.

nodes.label: Quando un prezzo scende
nodes.rationale: Recomputed total drops, but placed blocks remain because the registry remembers the highest point; the site pauses until new usage catches up. Archived sessions keep their original price.

nodes.label: Modalita dimostrativa (?demo)
nodes.rationale: Whole world in about 90 s with camera following; ?demo=N sets duration; never touches the registry, so the project can be seen without Claude Code.

nodes.label: Modalita sviluppo (?dev)
nodes.rationale: Single placement, continuous build, gifted simulation credit and 'Tutto in 10 s'; gifted credit stays in the browser and never reaches the registry.

nodes.label: Il laboratorio (torre di prova)
nodes.rationale: Surfaces dev modes and the world template from the home page instead of hiding them in the URL; nothing there consumes credit.

nodes.label: Scritture del registro solo locali, JSON, da pagine TokenStone
nodes.rationale: Only two writes ('scegli mondo', 'riporta avanzamento') accepted from localhost as JSON from TokenStone pages so another site in the browser cannot alter the site; server listens only locally because state reveals work habits.
nodes.norm_label: scritture del registro solo locali, json, da pagine tokenstone

nodes.label: Ricarica automatica su nuova versione / scollegato dal cantiere
nodes.norm_label: ricarica automatica su nuova versione / scollegato dal cantiere

nodes.label: Avvio a doppio clic (TokenStone.cmd / .command / tokenstone.sh)
nodes.rationale: Server need not stay on: transcripts are the site's memory and the counter catches up on start; caveat is Claude Code deletes transcripts older than a month.

nodes.label: La roccia affiorante non si paga
nodes.rationale: Bedrock existed before; everything carried up by hand costs tokens.
nodes.norm_label: la roccia affiorante non si paga

nodes.label: Ordine dei pezzi e generatore con seme fisso
nodes.rationale: The site is 'the first N pieces of the list' and the registry remembers N; changing order or seed would make those N different pieces.
nodes.norm_label: ordine dei pezzi e generatore con seme fisso

nodes.label: Raffinatezze ottiche (REFINEMENTS)
nodes.rationale: Curved stylobate, inward column tilt 1:171, thickened corner columns, contracted corner intercolumniations; crepidoma goes from 36 to 108 blocks because a temple-wide block cannot curve.

nodes.label: HDRI al posto del cielo analitico (useHDRI)
nodes.rationale: Analytic sky keeps time of day as a continuous parameter with real solar equations for Athens' latitude; HDRI would give that up.
nodes.norm_label: hdri al posto del cielo analitico (usehdri)

nodes.label: Prestazioni: bakePhase e ombre su posa
nodes.rationale: Merging a closed phase's meshes per material drops draw calls from thousands to dozens; shadow map recomputed only on placement.
nodes.norm_label: prestazioni: bakephase e ombre su posa

nodes.label: Hook Stop e server Python/FastAPI (versioni precedenti)
nodes.norm_label: hook stop e server python/fastapi (versioni precedenti)

nodes.label: Convenzione: nomi in inglese, testi in italiano
nodes.norm_label: convenzione: nomi in inglese, testi in italiano

nodes.label: Regola: cio che vale per un mondo solo non va nel motore
nodes.rationale: Random scattering must use seeded from engine/random.js, never Math.random.
nodes.norm_label: regola: cio che vale per un mondo solo non va nel motore

nodes.label: Controllo unknown_models a inizio lavoro
nodes.rationale: pricing.json is never edited by hand or without user approval; always via the subagent which proposes first and applies on approval. pricing-test.json is never touched.

nodes.label: Il registro non si modifica a mano
nodes.norm_label: il registro non si modifica a mano

nodes.label: Decisioni prese (6 ottobre 2026)
nodes.rationale: English names; pause; carryover; per-world duration with a single WEEKLY_TE (plan-dependent, not world-dependent); Giza next; TokenStone everywhere; coming-soon cards; first launch chooses the world; visiting is not choosing.

nodes.label: Fase 1: il cantiere si calcola dal credito
nodes.norm_label: fase 1: il cantiere si calcola dal credito

nodes.label: Fase 2: piu mondi nella struttura (engine/ + worlds/)
nodes.rationale: The Greek kit stays in the Acropolis until a second world needs it.
nodes.norm_label: fase 2: piu mondi nella struttura (engine/ + worlds/)

nodes.label: Fase 4: il modello per i mondi nuovi
nodes.rationale: Template tower of 501 pieces in six phases from a fantasy miniature; scene header from world.json (data-world).
nodes.norm_label: fase 4: il modello per i mondi nuovi

nodes.label: Fase 6: la piana di Giza (kit egizio)
nodes.norm_label: fase 6: la piana di giza (kit egizio)

nodes.label: Subagente aggiorna-listino
nodes.rationale: A wrong price silently skews everyone's site, so the agent works in two stages and the user decides the second.

nodes.label: Modalita proposta (listino candidato)
nodes.rationale: Read unknown_models/model_fallbacks, fetch only the official Anthropic pricing page, write pricing.candidate.json, verify with check-pricing.js and two counter --dry-run runs, report total_te before/after, then stop.

nodes.label: Modalita applicazione (con rollback)
nodes.rationale: Backup to pricing.json.prima, swap in candidate, run npm test, restore on failure.

nodes.label: Regole: non inventare, non dedurre da proporzioni
nodes.rationale: Ratios differ per model (cache read is 1/10 input on Opus 5, 1/20 on Opus 5.5); missing entries stay out; never remove disappeared models since archived sessions may reference them; do not change te_per_usd or default_model.
nodes.norm_label: regole: non inventare, non dedurre da proporzioni

nodes.label: offline.html (TokenStone spento)
nodes.rationale: Shown by the service worker when the server is down, so it must stand alone: no external fonts, no server-dependent scripts.

nodes.label: worlds/_template/index.html (pagina scena del modello)
nodes.rationale: Header texts are data-world placeholders filled by the engine from world.json, so the template is world-agnostic.

nodes.label: fallito() boot error handler (template)
nodes.rationale: Boot screen removed from outside the scene module: if the import fails, code inside never runs and the message would stay forever without saying what went wrong.

nodes.label: Dock del cantiere (#dock: credito, prossimo blocco, comandi)
nodes.norm_label: dock del cantiere (#dock: credito, prossimo blocco, comandi)

nodes.label: Greek Temple (Acropolis) Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: Flat pixel-geometric temple: triangular pediment, terracotta frieze band, entablature, four columns and three-step stylobate; evokes the 'Acropoli' brand name.

nodes.label: icon-maskable-512.png (maskable PWA icon)
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed navy background with no rounded corners and the temple shrunk into the center safe zone so OS-applied masks (circle/squircle) do not crop the mark.

nodes.label: apple-touch-icon.png (iOS home screen icon)
nodes.rationale: Square full-bleed (180px) since iOS applies its own corner rounding.

nodes.label: Square Stone Base with Arched Door
nodes.norm_label: square stone base with arched door

nodes.label: Conical Slate Roof with Open Belfry
nodes.norm_label: conical slate roof with open belfry

nodes.label: Flat Ground Plane with Sky Gradient
nodes.norm_label: flat ground plane with sky gradient

nodes.label: Acropolis World Preview Render
nodes.rationale: Aerial 3/4 thumbnail of a low-poly 3D scene of the Athenian Acropolis, likely used as the world selection/preview image for the 'acropolis' world.

nodes.label: Parthenon-style Peripteral Temple
nodes.rationale: Largest building in the scene: long colonnaded temple with stacked-slab roof and red/blue painted frieze band, evoking original polychromy.

nodes.label: Propylaea / Western Building Cluster
nodes.rationale: Group of smaller block buildings (incl. a small Nike-like temple and a large polychrome-roofed hall) at the far end of the plateau; identification is approximate.

nodes.label: Procedural Hilltop Terrain with Perimeter Path
nodes.rationale: Rolling sandy hill with flat plateau, ring road/wall around the edge, scattered olive trees, hexagonal stones and small pillars; hazy beige fog backdrop.
nodes.norm_label: procedural hilltop terrain with perimeter path

nodes.label: Low-poly Instanced Scene Style
nodes.rationale: Buildings appear built from stacked slabs/blocks and repeated primitives (columns, trees, hex tiles), suggesting procedural or instanced generation with simple flat shading.

nodes.label: Forum World Preview (Roman Forum silhouette)
nodes.rationale: Placeholder silhouette shown until the world has a real scene: a triumphal arch with three passages and the surviving columns of a temple against the Palatine.

nodes.label: Giza World Preview (Giza plateau silhouette)
nodes.rationale: Placeholder silhouette shown until the world has a real scene: the three pyramids in diagonal as seen arriving from the south-east, with the Sphinx in front.

nodes.label: World Preview Placeholder Silhouette
nodes.rationale: Each world ships a 1600x1000 SVG silhouette with a shared dark sky gradient ('cielo', #1A2733 top) used as preview 'finche il mondo non ha una scena' (until the world has a scene).
